subject: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)

Team,

Quick summary: Alyssa left the company effective last week (exit note attached to the HR ticket). We need to fill the SRE oncall lead slot (currently an IC3 role) and I want to propose two paths for approval:

1) Internal transfer: move Rohan Mehta (Platform infra) into the oncall lead role and re-level him to IC4 given the expanded ownership (pager coordination + runbook ownership + incident postmortems across infra). This is the option I prefer for continuity and to avoid a multi-month hiring cycle.

2) External hire: open a full requisition and run with external recruiters. That will take longer and likely cost ~10-12% of first-year comp; we have a candidate in process (Elaine/TalentPartners) but no offer yet.

Attached: SRE_Oncall_Lead_JD_v2.pdf, comp-band-sre-2025.xlsx.

Asks:
- Marissa: can you confirm headcount availability / approach if we do an internal transfer (swap) vs an additional hire?
- Laura: finance sign-off on re-leveling Rohan (IC3->IC4) with proposed uplift within SRE band — I put a provisional range in the spreadsheet.
- David/Rishi: technical confirmation that Rohan can be onboarded into oncall in 2 weeks and that we can backfill his current role after.

Im copying Rohan so hes aware; we havent had a final conversation about the offer yet. Plan would be to get approvals today/tomorrow and issue an internal move offer early next week if youre aligned.

Thanks,
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

---

Subject: Re: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)

Vivek — thanks for the clear rundown. A few quick clarifying Qs before I mark headcount: 

- Is this headcount currently open (vacancy) or are you asking to net-new an IC4 slot? I need to know whether this will be a swap (move Rohan and backfill his role) or an additional FTE.
- Please confirm the proposed total cash range for Rohan if we relevel him. The comp sheet you attached has a provisional uplift but I need an explicit offer range to route to compensation committee if it exceeds band midpoint.
- If we do an internal transfer, HR needs the employees written acceptance before we can create a req for the backfill. Do we have Rohans preliminary agreement?

Ive flagged JIRA HR-HCQ-5123 and added the JD to the candidate folder. For transparency Ive also dropped a quick budget note in the Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSREjd2025.

If you can confirm those three bullets Ill confirm headcount and start the internal offer paperwork.

-Marissa
People Ops (Hiring Partner)
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)

Quick operational note from infra: Rohan is already acting as primary oncall escalation for two clusters and has ownership of the KV cache and cache-recovery runbooks. Functionally, the ramp to oncall lead is 1-2 weeks for day-to-day and about 4 weeks for full incident playbook ownership. I support the internal transfer.

On re-leveling: the role responsibilities are meaningfully higher than the prior IC3 description (were adding cross-team incident coordination and stakeholder comms). Id recommend IC4 but with a capped uplift so we stay within the SRE comp band for new IC4 hires. Proposed range for Rohan: $165,000 - $185,000 total cash (base + target bonus). That maps to the comp sheet but stays under the committee threshold for out-of-band requests (see comp-band-sre-2025.xlsx).

If we proceed with an internal move, I suggest we mark this as a swap: convert Rohan to Oncall Lead and open an external req for his current role (SRE Infra Eng) with a standard IC3 band. That keeps headcount neutral for Q3.

-Rishi
Head of ML Infra

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan_mehta@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jul 2025 15:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)

Thanks all — Finance view below.

We can approve an internal re-level/transfer to IC4 conditioned on two things:
1) The uplift remains within the documented SRE IC4 band and does not require a special comp committee sign-off. Based on Rishi s suggested $165k-$185k range, that looks OK on the surface but I need a final breakdown (base vs bonus) before I sign off.
2) Headcount neutrality: you should close the loop on backfilling Rohan's current role as an external requisition or use an open bench slot. If you can route this as a swap (no net-new), were good for Q3 budgets.

Marissa, please confirm paperwork timeline. Vivek/Rishi, please send me the proposed compensation split (base / target bonus) by EOD so I can finalize.

Laura Bennett
VP, Finance
Redwood Inference
Attachment: comp-band-sre-2025-excerpt.pdf

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 15 Jul 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SRE oncall lead backfill — transfer vs external hire (approval request)

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Final confirmation below and next steps: 

Decision: Proceed with internal transfer of Rohan Mehta into the SRE Oncall Lead role at IC4. This will be a headcount-neutral swap — we will open an external requisition to backfill Rohan's current IC3 position immediately.

Comp terms proposed (per Rishi):
- Total cash: $175,000 (midpoint of the suggested range)
- Breakout: Base $150,000 / Target bonus 16.7% (~$25,000)
This stays inside the SRE IC4 band and does not hit the comp committee threshold. Laura, please confirm offline if this split is acceptable; if so, Marissa can proceed with the internal offer paperwork.

Ramping and timeline: Rishi/David confirm 2-week operational ramp for oncall duties and 4-week to full incident ownership. Proposed start date for the new role: 2025-07-28. Well post the external req for the backfill (SRE Infra Eng, IC3) by EOD today; Elaine, if you have candidates who can start a 4-week notice, please push those profiles.

Marissa: please prepare internal offer docs and checklist (I attached a draft offer-plan-Rohan-draft.docx). Laura: if you can send a short approval reply (OK to proceed) Ill consider this finalized and notify Rohan.

Thanks all — will loop in CS for oncall rotation calendar update once Rohan accepts.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
